message: Link text "Learn more" doesn't say where it goes
hint: Read alone, as screen readers list links, it means nothing. Name the destination, e.g. "Read the spring guide".

message: Outlook button size is estimated; give the button a px width
hint: Outlook draws rounded buttons with a fixed-size shape, so td;dr guesses it from the text.

message: shorter items' backgrounds won't stretch in a wrapping row
hint: Wrapped items are separate inline blocks, so painted cards of different heights on one line stay ragged. Use align-items: flex-start to make that explicit.

message: a button in a growing wrapping item keeps its basis width
hint: The column grows but the button stays flex-basis wide; Outlook needs a px width for rounded corners.

message: flex-grow in a wrapping row is resolved at the design width (600px); below it, grown items keep that width as a cap
hint: On a phone, stacked grow items fill the line only up to their grown width, and a line stacks earlier than in the browser.
